title: streaming-checkpoint-and-idempotency-helpers-for-python-sdk
creator: Asha Patel
description: Add a set of ergonomic helpers in the Python SDK to: 1) produce typed streaming responses (dataclass + pydantic friendly) that can be checkpointed and resumed across process restarts, and 2) generate idempotency and retry-safe tokens for resumable streams and at-least-once retry policies. This reduces developer friction for long-running generation/aggregation workflows and prevents duplicate side effects when users retry streaming requests. The feature will include examples, tests, and migration guidance from the legacy dict-based StreamEvent API.
acceptance_criteria: SDK exposes a StreamingCheckpoint helper that can serialize/deserialize stream checkpoints as compact JSON strings
Checkpoints capture: last-processed-event-offset, partial-assembly state, schema-version, and an idempotency token reference
SDK exposes an IdempotencyToken factory for streaming requests that ties to request inputs and optional user-provided nonce
Typed streaming iterator works with both dataclasses and pydantic models and includes a minimal example in examples/streams/checkpoint_resume.py
End-to-end integration test simulating process crash and resume demonstrates no duplicate final outputs under default retry policy
Docs updated: migration guide from legacy StreamEvent dicts to typed streams with checkpoint examples
technical_notes: Checkpoint format must be versioned (v1 metadata field) to allow future schema changes
Prefer compact base64 JSON payload to keep checkpoint <= 2KB for typical flows
Use typing.Protocol for StreamSerializable to avoid tight coupling to pydantic/dataclass implementations

Retry/backpressure: helpers should integrate with existing SDK retry adapter and expose a hook to opt into at-least-once vs exactly-once semantics (best-effort), with doc warnings about external side effects
Performance: avoid heavy introspection on hot path. Cache field serializers and small binary blobs where possible
Security: do not embed PII in checkpoint payloads by default. Add opt-in fields for user metadata
progress_updates: 2026-02-28: spike complete — prototyped a checkpoint envelope and resume flow against local streaming stub (branch: feat/stream-checkpoints-spike). Observed ~1.8ms overhead per event for serialization on 1000-event streams.

2026-03-04: design review with PM/Design. Decision: provide high-level helpers and separate low-level primitives for teams that need custom checkpoint payloads. Agreed to keep default checkpoint small and put rich debug payloads behind a flag.

2026-03-07: initial API landed in a draft PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/6821) — includes StreamingCheckpoint class and IdempotencyToken util. Awaiting API review from @Lena Ortiz and @Chris Gomez.

2026-03-10: integrated pydantic and dataclass examples; added example script and local test harness — discovered edge-case with nested union types in pydantic models, added a transform hook to flatten transient state.

2026-03-12: addressed PR feedback on serialization size and opt-in debug metadata. Preparing follow-up PR for docs and migration guide. Plan to run integration test on CI with flaky network simulation before merging.
